messages:
tina_ops: Heads up — planning a driver+kernel maintenance for eu-west1 low-priority GPU pool Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC. Will do rolling reboots of 3 cohorts, ~15m per cohort. Link to runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-driver-roll.json
sam_irving: +1. Which pool exactly? will this touch dedicated customers?
deepa: It's the demo/spot-dense pool (gradients). Dedicated and reserved pools unaffected, but any jobs in spot pool will be evicted. We will trigger graceful eviction with 30m drain window.
jordan_sre: We should pin fallback routing to smaller models during window to avoid timeouts — routing policy ready in prod: `route:eu-west1->eu-west2:fallback-llm-small` ?
infra-bot: Scheduled window created: id=maint-20260305-01, ETA 2026-03-05T02:00:00Z. Notifying tenants with >1M tokens/day.
tina_ops: Correct. Also enabling faster prefix cache warmup after each cohort. Expect transient 5-10% latency blips for 5m after each cohort.
sam_irving: Cost question — do we want to enable burst backfill from us-west2? that'll use cross-region egress and extra GPUs.
deepa: My estimate: backfill for 30m would add ~0.8% monthly infra cost for eu usage, but reduces user errors. Recommend only enable if queue backlog > 120s.
jordan_sre: @oncall please monitor routing errors and model-fallback counters: dashboard /dash/maint/driver-roll (alert thresholds: fallback_rate > 2% for 10m)
tina_ops: One more ask — APAC team reported a marketing campaign Sat morning; can we shift start by 2h if needed? Keep me posted by EOD Friday.
sam_irving: I can delay by 2h if APAC flags it. For now marking tentative. :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-05T01:00:00Z (1h before) — runbook preflight checks will execute: `run preflight --cohort all`.
deepa: Preflight checklist: kernel images staged, driver 535.104 validated, canary cohort in az1 first. Logs: `sha256:abc123...` — will paste canary results in thread after smoke.
jordan_sre: Thanks — please paste smoke results. I'll prep rollback playbook and slack incident channel if fallback >5%.
tina_ops: Great. If nothing else, we'll proceed. Short status ping 30m before start. :eyes:
